# Scene-collection corpus (P0-18, WP-42)

Test fixture corpus of OBS scene collections under [`scenes/`](scenes/) for
the rust-rewrite: format conformance of the `obs-data` JSON engine
(P1-24.2/.3, P1-25.5) and the future scene-collection load paths.

**D4 (decided 2026-11-23) overrides P0-18.2 as originally written:** the
corpus is a mix of licence-compliant **public** material (public scene files
from open-source projects' repos) and **synthetic** fixtures (generated
files exercising the source/filter/transition ids of the in-tree plugins).
No private user collection, no consent log. Every file — public and
synthetic — was run through the anonymiser before committing.

- Anonymiser: [`anonymise.py`](anonymise.py) (strips absolute paths, URLs,
  stream keys, window titles; `--check` gates the corpus in CI,
  `--self-test` is its unit test)
- Synthetic generator: [`generate_corpus.py`](generate_corpus.py)
  (deterministic; `python3 generate_corpus.py` regenerates all `syn-*.json`)
- Load check (P0-18.3): [`LOAD-CHECK.md`](LOAD-CHECK.md) — 24/24 files
  parsed via `obs-data::io::data_create_from_json_file`; permanent check
  `crates/obs-data/tests/corpus_load_check.rs` (CI)

## Format

The 33.0.1 (pinned reference) frontend saves scene collections as `.json`
files (see `frontend/widgets/OBSBasic_SceneCollections.cpp`
`OBSBasic::Save`/`LoadData` in the pinned obs-studio checkout). The corpus
contains three file generations, which is intentional — the port and its
loaders must handle all of them:

| Generation                                  | Files                                                                            | Shape                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 33.0.1 (version 2, relative coordinates)    | `syn-*` (17), `public-goobs-docker`, `public-irl-homekit-blank`                  | full `obs_save_source` key set (`uuid`, `balance`, `monitoring_*`), scene items with `pos_rel`/`scale_rel`/`scale_ref`, top-level `audio` section where present, `version: 2` |
| 29–32 era (version 1, absolute coordinates) | `public-superbacked-screen-capture`, `public-flow-toggl-demo`, `syn-v1-absolute` | no `version`/`version: 1`, items without the `*_rel` keys, 33-style source entries                                                                                            |
| pre-29 legacy                               | `public-opencomputer-legacy`                                                     | old source shape (`mute` instead of `muted`, no `uuid`/`hotkeys`), old scene-item shape — what the 33.0.1 `OBSImporter` migrates                                              |

## Files, provenance and id coverage

Source / filter / transition ids per file (extracted from the committed
JSON). `scene`/`group` (built-in, libobs) are omitted from the lists.

## In-tree id coverage (P0-18.4 Done-when)

All source/filter/transition ids registered by in-tree plugins of the
pinned 33.0.1 checkout (`plugins/*/`, libobs built-ins) are covered by at
least one corpus file:

| Kind                                                    | Covered ids                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| libobs built-ins                                        | scene, group (all scene files)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| obs-browser (submodule)                                 | browser_source                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| image-source                                            | color_source, image_source, slideshow                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| obs-ffmpeg                                              | ffmpeg_source                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| text-freetype2 / obs-text                               | text_ft2_source, text_gdiplus                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| obs-filters                                             | async_delay_filter, basic_eq_filter, chroma_key_filter, clut_filter, color_filter, color_key_filter, compressor_filter, crop_filter, expander_filter, gain_filter, gpu_delay, hdr_tonemap_filter, invert_polarity_filter, limiter_filter, luma_key_filter, mask_filter, noise_gate_filter, noise_suppress_filter, scale_filter, scroll_filter, sdr_on_hdr_filter, sharpness_filter, upward_compressor_filter |
| nv-filters                                              | — gap (NVIDIA-only; see below)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| obs-vst / obs-vst3                                      | vst_filter, vst3_filter                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| obs-transitions                                         | cut_transition, fade_to_color_transition, fade_transition, obs_stinger_transition, slide_transition, swipe_transition, wipe_transition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| win-capture                                             | game_capture, monitor_capture, window_capture                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| win-dshow                                               | dshow_input                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| mac-capture / mac-avcapture / mac-syphon                | window_capture, monitor_capture, av_capture_input, syphon-input                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| linux-capture                                           | xcomposite_input, xshm_input, xshm_input_v2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| linux-pipewire                                          | pipewire-camera-source, pipewire-desktop-capture-source, pipewire-screen-capture-source, pipewire-window-capture-source                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| linux-v4l2                                              | v4l2_input                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| decklink                                                | decklink-input                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| obs-outputs / rtmp-services                             | – (outputs, not scene-collectable)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| audio (wasapi/coreaudio/pulse/alsa/jack/oss/sndio/asio) | wasapi_input_capture, wasapi_output_capture, wasapi_process_output_capture, coreaudio_output_capture, pulse_input_capture, alsa_input_capture, jack_output_capture, oss_input_capture, sndio_output_capture                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| frontend                                                | virtualcam_output                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| vlc-video                                               | vlc_source                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

**Listed gaps:**

- `nv_greenscreen_filter`, `nv_blur_filter`, `nv_background_blur_filter`,
  `nvidia_audiofx_filter` (nv-filters) — require an NVIDIA device to
  register; not exercised (the ids are string constants, the load path is
  id-agnostic; a synthetic entry would pin ids that a non-NVIDIA machine
  never sees — kept out deliberately).
- `asio_input_capture`, `asio_output` (win-asio) — Windows-only, exercised
  nowhere yet; add when the Windows audio path lands.
- `dshow_c353_h264`, `dshow_c985_h264` — encoders, not sources.
- `audio_line` — internal submix source, never user-creatable (not
  expected in collections).
- obs-websocket (submodule, not expanded in the pinned checkout) — no ids
  verifiable from the reference tree.
- encoders/outputs/muxers (`obs_x264`, `obs_nvenc_*`, `rtmp_output`, …)
  are not part of scene collections and are out of scope.

## Notes

- No NDI ids anywhere (per P0-18.2 "NDI-less"; the NDI plugin is not
  in-tree).
- Anonymised tokens: `ANON_PATH`, `ANON_URL`, `ANON_SECRET`,
  `ANON_WINDOW` — see `anonymise.py` for the exact classes.
- The pre-27 `current`/`profile`-format `.project_scene` files (the old
  extension) are intentionally absent: the 33.0.1 importer handles the
  pre-29 shape (`public-opencomputer-legacy.json` covers the oldest format
  still generated by OBS itself).
